name: Infer v1.3.0
body:
## Highlights
- Speculative decoding is enabled by default
- New [OpenAI-compatible](https://example.com/docs/api) batch endpoint

### Breaking changes
- Removed the deprecated `--legacy-scheduler` flag

### Bug fixes
* Fixed a memory leak when streaming long responses (#4512)
* Fixed tokenizer caching across workers

### Evaluation
With the default model: MMLU: 73.5, HumanEval 81.0%, GSM8K 88.2.
